title: Develop AI Teaching and Learning Resources for Compulsory Education in China (AAAI-23)
notes: AAAI-23 (top-tier, peer-reviewed), Vol.37 No.13 EAAI Symposium, 2024-07-15, DOI 10.1609/aaai.v37i13.26904, pp.16033-16039. Song, Yu, Yan, Zhang, Liu, Zhang, Lu (Beijing Normal Univ + Liyuan Primary School + Tencent). AI course now REQUIRED for compulsory education (grades 1-9). Developed AI knowledge structure + instructional resources based on Chinese national curriculum for info science & tech. Syllabus: 90 core concepts, 63 learning indicators, 27 teaching/learning resources, implemented. Used as model courses in teacher training; exemplary course in primary schools verified effectiveness.
